$description: The token half of the handoff-bundle fixture, named for the filename the shipped design gate honours verbatim (work_engine/directives/ui/design.ts, design_provided_without_contract). Values are transcribed verbatim from the :root block of ../design.html — the SAME artifact, split across two files, which is what makes this a bundle rather than a second fixture set. A value here that disagrees with design.html is a fixture defect, not a variant.
